title: Palm (London) to Starhemberg, German letter with ciphered passages, 1727 (BL Add MS 32270 ff. 16-17; DECODE R7927, R7930)

steps.what: Fetched DECODE metadata R7927-R7930 and the images of R7927, R7928 and R7930 with the saved cookie; R7929 has no images.
R7930 turned out to be only the cover of a Palm-Visconti letter plus a 1-500 French/Italian nomenclator worksheet; the letter itself is not imaged. R7928 is a Windischgraetz-Starhemberg key fragment.
Transcribed the 14 cipher passages of R7927 with their clear context and the interlinear glosses.
Applied the R7928 letter key: it contradicts the glosses (40=r vs long s, 23=u vs n).
Simulated annealing on letter values with de-modern 5-grams, codes drawn from a word/syllable list, gloss values pinned; 6+6+6 restarts.
Web search for a printed decipherment of Palm's 1727 intercepts.
Longer annealing (12 restarts x 250k moves) with six gloss pins: scores scattered -1985 to -2022, no two runs agree.

Synthetic German homophonic text of the same length and symbol count (162 tokens, 47 values), true values of the 6 commonest symbols pinned: solver recovered 81/162 and 71/162 tokens (two seeds), unreadable.

outcome.method_basis: R7927's 14 cipher passages were transcribed with their few contemporary glosses, but ciphertext-only annealing failed and a same-size control showed the text is too short; the R7928 key fragment contradicts the glosses.
outcome.notes: Closed as infeasible ciphertext-only: a same-size control with correct pins reaches only 44-50% token accuracy. Needs Palm's key or the Deciphering Branch clear copy.

prior.where: Probably read at the time by the Deciphering Branch; no clear copy on DECODE, none found in print

human: Selected the target; the DECODE session cookie was supplied earlier.
